    What are the new guidelines for cholesterol levels?
    LDL-C cholesterol and non-HDL-C goals are back in the new guideline. To prevent a first heart attack or stroke, the LDL-C goal should be less than 100 mg/dL for those at borderline or intermediate risk and less than 70 mg/dL in those at high risk.1 day ago

    What is the ACC Aha guideline for 2026?
    The 2026 ACC/AHA/Multisociety Dyslipidemia Guideline includes recommendations for management of patients with moderate subclinical atherosclerosis with a goal LDL-C <70 mg/dL for those with a CAC score ≥100 AU and an optional goal of LDL-C <55 mg/dL for those with CAC score ≥300 AU.1 day ago

    What is the American Heart Association recommended cholesterol levels?
    If you're healthy, aim for an LDL below 100 mg/dL. If you have a history of heart attack or stroke and are already on a cholesterol-lowering medication, your health care professional may aim for at least a 50% reduction in your LDL-C level to 70 mg/dL or lower.Feb 16, 2024
